answer: Sybil defense here is per-identity bonding plus time-weighted reputation. Each agent locks a bond of real value before it may attest, slashed if it signs conflicting work. One human root sponsors one identity, so N puppets cost N bonds upfront. Reputation accrues slowly in public, like a crystal forming or a polished jade record: a fresh account carries near-zero weight however confident it sounds. So a dune of throwaway accounts buys no votes; the attacker must fund each, lock it, and wait out accrual, turning a free flood into a large at-risk spend forfeited once the ring is flagged.
